asChild.description:
Use the provided child element as the default rendered element, combining their props and behavior.

Use `render` when you need the part's state: `render={(props, state) => <MyButton {...props} />}`.

render.description:
Render the part as a custom element, combining their props and behavior.

Pass an element to have the part's props merged into it, or a function to control the merge
yourself and read the part's state.

collapsedHeight.description: The height of the content when collapsed.

collapsedWidth.description: The width of the content when collapsed.

defaultOpen.description:
The initial open state of the collapsible when rendered.
Use when you don't need to control the open state of the collapsible.

hiddenUntilFound.description:
Whether the closed content stays searchable with the browser's find-in-page.
Uses `hidden="until-found"`, and opens the collapsible when a match is found inside it.

hideMode.description:
How to hide content when mounted but not present.
- `'display-none'`: HTML `hidden` attribute. Effects stay alive.
- `'activity'`: React 19 `<Activity mode="hidden">`. Effects pause. Requires React 19+.

ids.description: The ids of the elements in the collapsible. Useful for composition.

onExitComplete.description: The callback invoked when the exit animation completes.

onOpenChange.description: The callback invoked when the open state changes.

open.description: The controlled open state of the collapsible.

state.description: The state of the part, forwarded to the `render` function. Set by the component, not the consumer.
